body:
## Pull request overview

This PR improves documentation reliability by fixing broken links in the docs and adding automated link validation using Lychee in CI.

**Changes:**
- Added a `check-links` GitHub Actions workflow using `lycheeverse/lychee-action` and a `.lycheeignore` file to automatically detect broken links in markdown/MDX.
- Updated documentation tooling guidance in `CONTRIBUTING.md` to reflect the current fumadocs-based setup and added explicit link conventions for `/docs`-prefixed routes.
- Fixed multiple broken or inconsistent documentation links across the docs index and plugin pages, including adding `/docs/` prefixes and cleaning up `.md` extensions.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `.github/workflows/check-links.yml` | Introduces Lychee-based link checking in CI, scanning docs and README for broken links; current `content/**` globs don’t match the actual `apps/site/content` location. |
| `.lycheeignore` | Configures Lychee to ignore localhost, example.com, and social media URLs to reduce false positives in link checks. |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | Updates documentation tooling instructions to fumadocs, adjusts dev/build commands, and documents required `/docs/` link patterns and automated link validation behavior. |
| `docs/index.md` | Fixes hero and “Quick Links” section to use `/docs/`-prefixed internal URLs; other sections in this file still contain non-prefixed links that should be updated for consistency. |
| `docs/plugins/plugin-object.mdx` | Normalizes related-docs links by removing `.md` extensions and keeping `/docs/`-prefixed paths. |
| `docs/plugins/plugin-markdown.mdx` | Adjusts internal API reference and contributing links; the API reference URL should be aligned with the actual `/docs/reference/api/core` entry point. |
</details>

## Unused variable, import, function or class

Unused variable relativePath.

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/security/code-scanning/76)

The updated API reference link `/docs/reference/api` likely does not resolve because there is no `docs/reference/api.md` or `docs/reference/api/index.md`; existing docs use `/docs/reference/api/core` as the canonical API entry point. Please update this link to match the actual API reference path used elsewhere (for example `/docs/reference/api/core`) to avoid 404s and keep link patterns consistent.
```suggestion
For more information, see the [API Reference](/docs/reference/api/core).
```

This section updates the hero and Quick Links to use the `/docs/` prefix, but further down in this same file there are still internal links like `/guide/quick-start`, `/components/`, and CTA buttons that point to non-prefixed paths. To avoid 404s and keep internal links consistent with the documented `/docs/` convention, please update the remaining links in `docs/index.md` to include the `/docs/` prefix as well (e.g., in the "Getting Started" list and the final call-to-action buttons).

The link checker is configured to scan `content/**/*.md` and `content/**/*.mdx`, but there is no top-level `content/` directory in the repo (the existing content lives under `apps/site/content/`). This means those globs currently match nothing, so the workflow does not validate links in the site content as suggested in the PR description; consider pointing the globs at the actual content path or updating the description to match what is being scanned.
